Class Projects











Course #
Course Name
Quarter




Stats 170
Introduction to Time-Series Analysis

Developed and executed a comprehensive time-series analysis on 13 years of Amazon (AMXN) closing prices to evaluate and forecast log-return trends.
Tested and compared multiple candidate models to justify modeling decisions.
Evaluated model adequacy by performing diagnostic checks, residual analysis, and autocorrelation testing to validate statistical assumptions.
Designed a technical report using Quarto in R to generate data visualizations and document statistical findings.

Spring 2026


Stats C173
Applied Geostatistics

Engineered a spatial data pipeline in R to analyze EPA’s Outdoor Air Quality dataset, focusing on Ozone metrics, executing non-spatial exploratory data analysis (EDA) and auditing coordinated structures to ensure unique data points.
Constructed and analyzed h-scatterplots and empirical variograms to model spatial continuity, directional dependence, and geometric anisotropy across target coordinate spaces.
Deployed theoretical variogram models and Kriging algorithms to predict continuous Ozone concentrations across unsampled regions throughout California.
Validated model performance by conducting rigorous cross-validation and residual analysis to quantify prediction error and ensure statistical adequacy.

Winter 2026


Stats 133
Introduction to Text Mining Using R

Engineered a text mining pipeline in R to clean, tokenize, and analyze text data from the Billboard Top 100 hits spanning from 1959 to 2023.
Conducted sentiment analysis and emotion mining using the VADER and NRC lexicons to quantify emotional shifts and linguistic trends in popular music across the decades. Developed data visualizations in R using ggplot2 to chart emotional trajectories and deployed the wordcloud2 package to isolate the most frequent terms.
Compiled a cohesive report that synthesized advanced natural language processing (NLP) metrics with analytical commentary and data-driven insights.

Winter 2026


Stats 140XP
Practice of Statistical Consulting

Conducted exploratory data analysis (EDA) on LAPD traffic collision data to identify patterns and trends. Developed research questions based on insights from the EDA.
Applied statistical models, using R, to analyze data and draw meaningful conclusions for each research question.
Compiled and presented results in a comprehensive report, relating findings to external sources.

Fall 2025


Stats 101A
Introduction to Data Analysis and Regression

Cleaned and conducted exploratory data analysis on raw data sets to identify patterns and trends using Python.
Evaluated statistical models, selecting the best algorithm based on evaluation metrics and feature importance rankings.
Built an end-to-end pipeline to split data into training and test sets, generating final predictions on unseen data, and exporting results to CSV.
